subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram forum topic title-to-topic_id routing, and should that contract be a message action, agent context catalog, or plugin/channel metadata endpoint?
rationale: Current main intentionally exposes topic names after a numeric thread ID is known; choosing forward routing affects Telegram action semantics, cache freshness, duplicate titles, and what agents or plugins may rely on.

options.title: Expose observed topic catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog surface that returns known topic IDs, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add resolver-only helper
options.body: Add a direct title-to-topic_id helper that fails with structured stale or ambiguous errors instead of silently routing on weak matches.

options.title: Keep numeric-only routing
options.body: Document that topic names are display/context metadata only and require numeric topic IDs or chatId:topic:threadId for routing.

recommendation.title: Expose observed topic catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog surface that returns known topic IDs, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can choose or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history covers both adjacent topic-name flow and Telegram action normalization, the two surfaces most likely to anchor the contract decision.
